scope: Fiche personne : API, données, historique et suppression

defects.cause: Inherited object properties passed the history section allowlist
Identity and last-change provenance were read without a common snapshot
defects.testOrdering: Prisma query extension waits for an actual concurrent PATCH commit immediately before the reader's audit lookup; queries and returned rows are real PostgreSQL operations

sqlCoverage.group: identity normalization, no-op, versions and concurrent writers
primary contact transitions across three collections
foreign child and parent/child version rejection
shared contact warning without other-person disclosure
bounded exact history with encrypted storage
versioned deletion, cascade, purge, retry, rollback and reused operation key

limits: Next cookies/headers are simulated; users and authenticated MFA sessions are SQL fixtures
No HTTP middleware/CSRF or real password/TOTP login proof in this bench
No prolonged concurrency or volume benchmark
History retains the existing maximum of two events; UI provenance consumes only the latest
No production data, project database or browser integration database used
